Cost: 7,500eb (Super Luxury)
Class: EQ Assault Rifle
Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Flared Magwell (w/ Extended Magazine), Magrail Kit (w/ Kanetsugu Short Scope & Silencer), Power Rebuild, Sling, Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Assault Rifle 4), Suppressive Fire

In Single Shot, fire 1 extra round (2 total) to ignore Critical Failures on the attack check (no implosion roll; the die still counts as a 1). Without BODY 10+, paired Cyberarms, or a mount, Autofire checks take -4.

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 6d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
